review: The hymn is the invitation of Matt 11:28: 1:1–4 is Matt 11:28 with Gal 6:2, the chorus is Prov 18:10 with Ps 91:1, 2:1–4 is Matt 11:28 (quoted) with Isa 32:2, and 3:1–4 is Ps 36:9 with Jer 17:14.
The chorus follows stanza 1 and is printed as [القرار]; the payload keeps it as the labelled second stanza, so the structure is invitation–promise–invitation–promise.

2:4 בְּצֵל צִלּוֹ הַמֵּצַל — the Arabic بِظِلِّهِ الظَّلِيل doubles the shadow-word; the Hebrew reproduces the figure with the cognate צֵל / מֵצַל rather than substituting 'protection', because the double shadow is the stanza's image of shelter.
